algorithm: Increasing budgets0..13, each with exact cardinality upper bound and minimum degree. For each satisfying assignment test all low-degree biconnected blocks. A non-Gallai induced block yields a universally necessary clause forbidding all its vertices being low. Keep cuts across budgets. Stop at the first full-Gallai witness or certified infeasibility through13.
conditional_candidate_test: If a full-Gallai witness has <=13 selectors, make at most one arbitrary-interior right-colouring query at2000000 conflicts/30seconds. Preserve a positive gluing witness or separately checked negative proof. No cover refinement loop.
objective: Prove the minimum number of additional selectors satisfying all45 known positive-cover cuts, minimum degree4 on every selected vertex, and the full Gallai condition on all degree4 vertices, within target budget13. If none exists, prove whole-family closure at <=508.
validation: Independently reconstruct coordinates, cover cuts, degrees, low graph and both CNFs. Independently check DRAT for the lower bound and a direct support witness for the upper bound.
